description: Welikanda Pradeshiya Sabha - Declare that Mr. S. M. A. Pushpa Kumara of the Welikanda Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of the member of that Pradeshiya  Sabha as he has been ceased to be a member of the United National Party
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Welikanda Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This is an electoral matter specifically related to local authorities elections, falling under the category of electoral processes and declarations as outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
